usageNotes: Use this endpoint to audit all TFA configurations across users in the Proxmox Datacenter Manager instance. Unprivileged users receive only their own entry; admin-level access is required to see all users. The response also surfaces lockout state — check `totp-locked` and `tfa-locked-until` to identify accounts currently blocked from second-factor authentication.
tips: A user with no TFA entries will not appear in the result array; absence from the list means no TFA is configured, not that the request failed.
The `tfa-locked-until` field is only present when a lockout is active — always check for its existence before reading it.
Entry type `recovery` indicates one-time recovery codes; audit these alongside `totp` and `webauthn` entries when reviewing security posture.
API tokens (`allowtoken: true`) can call this endpoint, making it safe for automated compliance scans without exposing a user password.
